# STL and OBJ corpus

Own files are generated by `scripts/generate-corpus.mjs` (deterministic; licence AGPL-3.0-or-later, same as this module).
All own files describe one box, 10 x 20 x 30 with its minimum corner at (1, 2, 3): 12 triangles, bounds (1,2,3)-(11,22,33), 8 vertices after welding.
Oracle = three.js 0.186.1 `STLLoader` / `OBJLoader` (`node scripts/oracle-counts.mjs`). admesh is not installed here, so it is not recorded.
Oracle counts are triangles, then bounds as three.js returns them.

| File | What it is | three.js oracle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| box-binary.stl | binary STL, header `binary box` | 12, (1,2,3)-(11,22,33) |
| box-ascii.stl | ASCII STL | 12, same bounds |
| box-ascii-crlf.stl | ASCII STL, CRLF line ends, indented, tabs, trailing blanks | 12, same bounds |
| box-binary-solid-header.stl | binary STL whose 80-byte header starts with `solid` | 12, same bounds |
| box-binary-truncated.stl | binary, cut inside the sixth triangle | throws (read past end) |
| box-binary-count-too-large.stl | header declares 20, 12 present | throws (read past end) |
| box-binary-count-too-small.stl | header declares 10, 12 present (trailing data) | 10 (ignores the rest): our parser must reject |
| box-binary-nan.stl | one NaN x coordinate | 12, x bounds NaN |
| box-binary-infinite.stl | one -Infinity x coordinate | 12, min x -Infinity |
| box-binary-header-only.stl | 60 bytes, shorter than the 84-byte header | throws |
| box-quads.obj | OBJ, 6 quad faces | 12 (triangulated), same bounds |
| box-negative-indices.obj | OBJ, relative (negative) indices | 12, same bounds |
| box-groups.obj | OBJ, `o` and two `g` groups, `v/vt/vn` and `v//vn` forms | 12, same bounds |
| box-index-out-of-range.obj | OBJ, third face names vertex 9 of 8 | 3 triangles, NaN bounds: our parser must reject |

| cura-Hellbot_Magna_2_230.obj | `resources/meshes/Hellbot_Magna_2_230.obj` (vertex colours, 32 KB) | 260, (-117.5,-127.5,-1.0002)-(117.5,117.5,1.0002) |
